Melee weapons and some tools also carry §6weapon abilities§r, which trigger on every hit. They are always active and listed in the tooltip.

- §6Radioactive Blade§r - contaminates the target with 15 to 500 RAD.
- §6Vampire§r - heals you for part of the damage, from 2 up to 50 health.
- §6Stunning§r - Slowness and Weakness V for 2 to 15 seconds.
- §6Phosphorus Tip§r - §cPhosphorus Burns§r that cannot be put out for 60 or 90 seconds.
- §6Flaming§r - sets the target on fire.
- §6Painsaw§r - a killed mob bursts into gore and drops §6Small Piles of Nitra§r and experience, one per 10-15 points of its max health.
- §6Decapitator§r - a killed mob drops its head: skeleton, zombie, creeper and player skulls, a rare wither skeleton skull, slimeballs from slimes and magma cream from magma cubes.
- §6Luck of the Collector§r - every kill has a tiny chance to drop a random §6Bobblehead§r.
